name: Servo Cycler
introduction: Servo tester by ABRC: cycles servos a set number of times (1-999) at 30 cycles/min with buttery smooth motion (the mixer's Slow setting moves the servos). Dashboard with servo-arm cycle dial, progress bar, temperature bars, current, RX battery, travel and cycles dials.

releaseNotes.content:
## 1.8.7
- Model pictures (PNG) for X20, X18 / Twin, X14 and X10 / X12S in the zip folder model-images (copy to bitmaps/models)

## 1.8.6
- No automatic start at power-up: if the start switch is already ON, switch it OFF and ON to start
- Temperature bars only show for sensors with live telemetry

## 1.8.5
- Plug and A / V readouts moved closer to the servo, away from the right dial

## 1.8.4
- Set Slow up and Slow down to 0.5 s (30 cycles/min, full travel)
- Cycles dial coloured green up to 66 %, then gradually red
- A and V readouts a little lower and further from the right dial

## 1.8.2
- Slow up / Slow down must be 0.5 s (Ethos counts the slow time for 100 %, centre to end) for full travel at 30 cycles/min

## 1.8.1
- No more jerk at the centre: between cycles the servo sweeps straight from one end to the other; only the last cycle stops at the centre

## 1.8.0
- Smooth motion: the mix Slow up/down  moves the servos; the script only sets the end points, so screen refreshes can no longer cause stutter
- Fixed speed 30 cycles/min, speed knob and waveform removed
- Pot 2 sets the number of cycles (exponential), shown on the bottom right dial
- In every Servo Cycler mix set Slow up and Slow down (see 1.8.2)

## 1.6.1
- Fixed "Max instructions count" error: the dashboard is prepared in small steps and drawn with much less work
- Target slider is exponential: fine control for small numbers of cycles (25 % = 16, 50 % = 125, 75 % = 420)
- Bottom dials default to Travel left, Speed right
- Error messages disappear after 15 s

## 1.6.0
- New dashboard layout
- Top bar fills green with the progress: elapsed | RUNNING | time left
- Big CYCLES dial with a servo: the arm is the pointer, the count is on the case
- Current (A) and RX battery (V) at the end of the servo wire
- Temperatures as colour bars (green to red)
- Travel dial bottom left, speed dial bottom right, coloured by value
- Logo with SERVO CYCLER title top left

## 1.5.2
- RX battery shows the actual voltage only
- Short sensor names (first word, e.g. SRV2)
- Larger RUNNING / DONE status
- Larger logo, right below the status

## 1.5.1
- RX battery voltage

## 1.5.0
- Temperatures (8 sensors, 4 hottest), current, cycle time and elapsed

## 1.0.0
- First release
